items.title: 🔴 LIVE: Belgium Brings 15 Defence Firms to India | OpenAI Unveils GPT-6 Astra | Front Page
items.summary:
Belgium brought a delegation of 15 leading defence companies to India, unveiling 10 strategic industrial outcomes spanning rockets, ammunition, drones, mine warfare, tank turrets, and advanced manufacturing partnerships under the 'Make in India' framework. Globally, OpenAI launched its flagship GPT-6 Astra model, Tesla initiated public Cybercab rides in Austin under NHTSA review, and Adobe appointed Anil Chakravarthy as its next President and CEO starting December 1, 2026. Domestically, deeptech startup Pranos Fusion unveiled the PRAGYA tokamak testbed, NITI Aayog advised Karnataka to establish four twin-city regions to build a "second Bengaluru," and Vahan.ai CEO Madhav Krishna joins us live to break down voice AI recruitment for blue-collar workers.
